rights_and_cost.summary: Global default CC BY-SA4.0 is not a universal item license. Both inspected English guides label CC BY-SA3.0; ported/open-access exceptions require item-level attribution.

facts.metadata: API supplies page/revision/snippet metadata; no separate blanket metadata reuse license established. Keep attribution and article license alongside extracted text.
facts.content_default: Copyrights page: CC BY-SA4.0 unless otherwise noted. Siteinfo default is4.0.
facts.item_exceptions: Micro-irrigation and solar-cooker page data label CC BY-SA3.0. Practical Action is original source for micro-irrigation; original project authors listed on solar page. Global footer does not override explicit item license.
facts.ported_content: Ported-content policy requires compatible licensing/permission and original author/organization/source URL credit. Open-access-only material such as some CD3WD/WikiGreen content must not be presumed copyable/modifiable.
facts.other_media: Hardware may use CERN-OHL-S; software licenses and embedded external media differ. No hardware/software/audio/video downloads.
facts.cost: No account/key/payment needed for observed requests. No numeric quota or unlimited-use promise.
facts.ai_policy: Contribution policy includes AI-assisted publishing conditions; no contributions or publication to Appropedia performed.

open_questions: Resolve metadata reuse and original-author/license history for each retained item, including Hindi translation; no universal license inference.

quality_and_relevance.summary: Topic and native-ID matches are reproducible, while broad topical pages, historical projects and practical safety need separate review.

facts.topic_relevance: Drip irrigation, solar cooker, composting, anaerobic digestion and rainwater harvesting are topical; general Gardening appears lower in irrigation results. Keyword relevance does not establish a complete step-by-step guide.

facts.safety: General disclaimer says information may be inaccurate/outdated and is not professional advice; student-project success/deployed labels do not establish current safety or regulatory compliance.

open_questions: Review intended-use relevance and translation quality across examples; preserve age/geography/context warnings.

operating_limits.summary: Serial three-second requests, small response caps and no retries preserve policy/error evidence. Robots has a published same-host redirect ending404.
